stock.counterargument: The honest counterargument is the sample: this process has not been shown to work, and a single ranking position is not evidence about one company.
invalidation: Quarterly revenue growth falling below +47.8%, the rate it was running at the quarter before.
Cash conversion dropping below 1.0×, meaning earnings stop being backed by cash.
A close below the 200-session average, which stood at $55.29 on the decision date.
risks: The most recent filing covers a period ending 2026-10-30, 18 days before the decision date.
Point-in-time fundamentals are built from filings accepted up to 2026-11-17.

earnings.basis: the same fiscal quarter's announcement a year earlier (2026-02-27) plus 364 days

stock.rule: Universe: every US-listed common stock on NYSE, Nasdaq or NYSE American — about 4,700 names from Nasdaq Trader's own file. Eligible means: priced at $5 or more, median daily turnover of $20M or more over 60 sessions, at least 253 sessions of history, a 10-Q or 10-K whose period ended within 200 days, close above the 200-session average, volatility inside the day's 85th percentile, debt no more than 6× operating cash flow, no results announced in the last 2 sessions, and no position already open in the stock or a fourth in the same SIC division. Eligible candidates are then ranked on equally weighted z-scores within their sector group, over the signals that are defined for that group. One position per session, held 21 sessions, a twenty-first of capital each, 10 basis points of cost each way. Fundamentals are read as they stood on the decision date, never as they read today. The score is a ranking position among that day's eligible candidates. It is not a probability, a price target, or a forecast of any return.
stock.validation: The held-out window has not been opened. No claim of an edge is made or implied.

stories.lead:
Instagram is filled with people posting deepfaked content — including, as of late, from one of Meta’s most prominent executives.

Earlier in November, Alexandr Wang, Meta’s chief AI officer, shared a short clip to promote Muse, the company’s consumer AI agent. In the AI-generated clip, Wang, Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, and Jolly, the anthropomorphic mascot of Muse, are on a four-way video call. When Altman joins the call he’s dressed like Jolly, wearing a furry hooded suit and face paint to look like the cutesy character. The clip is captioned “When the homies meet about openai product strategy,” a reference to the AI agent race and the recent popularity of Muse.

stories.title: Rubio says there's 'zero' information that U.S. outages are caused by a malign actor
stories.excerpt: Secretary of State Marco Rubio sought to calm Americans as he traveled with President Trump and they prepared for key meetings with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.
stories.lead:
MANILA, Philippines — Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Tuesday sought to assure Americans that there's "zero" information that the cascade of service outages, which snarled travel, cut off work, limited bank access and disrupted classified communications, are related to each other or to a malign actor.

Rubio sought to calm Americans as he traveled with President Donald Trump and they prepared to leave the Philippines for key meetings with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin in the tech hub of Shenzhen, China.

stories.title: Ghana's new $60m presidential jet sparks public outrage
stories.excerpt: The purchase has sparked outrage over its cost as many Ghanaians struggle with rising cost of living.
stories.lead:
Manufactured by French aerospace company Dassault Aviation, the aircraft was delivered to the Ghana Air Force on Monday at a reported cost of $61m.

Parliament approved its purchase last December as part of a broader programme to modernise Ghana's military aviation fleet, which also includes four helicopters from Airbus.

The jet was welcomed with a water salute on Monday, but its arrival triggered criticism online and among opposition politicians over the cost and timing of the purchase.

stories.title: Philippines police ask prosecutors to charge Thomas Markle over child sex abuse material
stories.excerpt: Markle is being held in custody in the US after one charge and has previously denied all of the allegations.
stories.lead:
Police in the Philippines have asked prosecutors to charge Thomas Markle Sr, the father of Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, with possession of and intent to distribute child sexual abuse material.

Cebu province prosecutor Graeme Elmido told the BBC that police had filed documents requesting that Markle be charged on Monday.

Earlier this month, Markle, 82, was separately arrested and charged in the US with possession of child sexual abuse material. The FBI said agents seized about 78 items, including film negatives, slides and books that they allege contained child sex abuse material, from storage units Markle rented.

stories.title: Higher petrol and diesel prices push UK inflation to 3.6%
stories.excerpt: There are also signs inflation is impacting the wider economy, with the cost raw materials and goods leaving factories climbing.
stories.lead:
Higher petrol and diesel prices pushed the UK's inflation rate up again last month, official figures show.

Prices rose 3.6% in the year to October, up from 3.5% in September, the Office for National Statistics (ONS) said.

Elevated oil prices also affected the wider economy, the ONS said, continuing to drive up the cost of raw materials and goods leaving factories.

stories.title: MP urges council to speed up heating oil payments
stories.excerpt: About 23,000 households use heating oil in Northumberland and face increasing bills this winter.
stories.lead:
An MP has urged a council to speed up the process of heating oil support payments as energy prices soar.

About 23,000 Northumberland homes use oil systems as they are not connected to the mains gas supply.

Labour's North Northumberland MP David Smith said a freedom of information request from 21 September showed just over a third of households who applied for help with heating oil costs had received funding from Northumberland County Council.

stories.title: Has Vini Jr. finally put summer transfer saga behind him? Real Madrid need him at his best
stories.excerpt: After a summer of transfer uncertainty and a sluggish start to the season, Vinícius Junior is on the comeback trail with Real Madrid and Brazil.
stories.lead:
Vinícius Júnior has earned hundreds of millions of euros thanks to his feet. Thunderous goals off his instep, intuitive, imaginative crosses bending in from his outstep, defender-fooling step-overs while full-tilt sprinting at 35kmh. The Real Madrid and Brazil star is a winger who's often been a few steps ahead of opponents.

But the metaphorical "first step" that the 26-year-old took in Singapore on Monday -- starting to solve a problem by admitting that there has been one -- might be the best foot forward he's taken in many months.
